trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Read in full: 7-row quantity/value table at q_0. No prose sentences; none of the ten constructions present.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Table-only block. RECOMPUTED at the proton pin q_0 = 1.1099785827513808 (mpmath, 40 dps): h = q - 1/q = 0.2090603 (stated 0.209, ok); h^4 = 0.0019102327 (stated 0.00191, ok); 1/(q^2 (q^9-q^-9)^2 (q^10-q^-10)^2) = 0.0279636710 (stated 0.0280, ok) -- and this identity implies alpha_EM = 0.0073087016, i.e. 1/alpha = 136.8232, so the row 'alpha_EM^2 = 5.34e-5' is the FRAMEWORK-DERIVED alpha, not CODATA (5.3251e-5); the row is unlabelled as a prediction. Consequently E_HARTREE = 27.30 eV is m_e c^2 times the framework alpha^2 (27.2961), 0.33 percent ABOVE the physical Hartree energy 27.2114 eV, and the cited witness h2-molecular-binding.witness.json itself records E_hartree_eV = 27.211467573 and alpha_EM = 0.0072973560 (CODATA). STALE-WITNESS DEFECT reported separately: the rows 'Phi_1 binding 0.687' and 'E_bind 4.64 eV' are the PRE-proton-pin values; the current witness gives binding_Phi_diff = 0.12847273 and E_bind_eV_predicted = 0.86453646 with allPassed FALSE. The pins are indistinguishable at this printed precision (proton and muon q_0 agree to 8 significant figures).
